prompt: Create a vertical anime-style gothic portrait illustration of a beautiful androgynous young man lying diagonally on deep crimson, black-patterned fabric, hugging a worn tan teddy bear close to his chest. The character has silvery white tousled medium-length hair with long bangs covering part of one eye and a short side ponytail tied behind the ear, pale skin, soft pink eyes, long lashes, and a faint mischievous smile with slightly parted lips. Dress him in a formal dark burgundy-black suit jacket, white dress shirt, black ribbon bow tie, and white gloves, with dramatic glossy folds and sharp tailoring. The teddy bear is tan and plush, with exactly one black button eye visible, one pale square eye patch over the other eye, a small black nose, simple stitched mouth, rounded ears, two arms, and two legs. Surround them with sewing and dollmaking details on the fabric: exactly one open pair of scissors on the left edge, exactly two dark thread spools with metallic rims at the top-right and bottom-right corners, thin loose threads, lace trim along the right side, and exactly four red flower blossoms plus scattered small red petals. Use a close-up tilted composition, the character's face near the upper center and the teddy bear centered, with warm golden rim light across the hair and face, cool cyan edge accents in the shadows, rich reds and blacks, high contrast, painterly brush texture, crisp line art, intricate hair strands, luxurious gothic mood, intimate and slightly eerie atmosphere. No text, no watermark, no extra characters.

promptZh: 创作一张竖版动漫风格的哥特肖像插画，画面中 一位美丽的中性风年轻男子 对角斜躺在深红色带有黑色花纹的织物上，怀中紧紧抱着一只破旧的棕色泰迪熊。角色留着 银白色 凌乱的中长发，长刘海遮住部分眼睛，耳后扎着一束短侧马尾，皮肤苍白，有着柔和的粉色双眸、长睫毛，嘴角带着一丝顽皮的微笑，双唇微启。他身穿正式的深酒红色配黑色西装外套、白色衬衫、黑色丝带领结和白色手套，衣物呈现出富有光泽的褶皱和利落的剪裁。泰迪熊为棕色毛绒材质，仅露出一只黑色纽扣眼，另一只眼睛上贴着浅色方形眼罩，有着黑色小鼻子、简单的缝线嘴、圆耳朵，以及两条手臂和两条腿。在织物周围点缀缝纫和玩偶制作细节：左边缘放置一把打开的剪刀，右上角和右下角各有一个带有金属边缘的深色线轴，周围散落着细线，右侧饰有蕾丝花边，并点缀四朵红花及散落的小片花瓣。采用近景倾斜构图，角色面部位于上方中心附近，泰迪熊位于画面中心，发丝和面部带有温暖的金色轮廓光，阴影处带有冷青色边缘点缀，色彩以浓郁的红黑为主，高对比度，具有绘画感的笔触，线条清晰，发丝细节精致，营造出奢华的哥特氛围，整体感觉亲密且略带诡异。无文字，无水印，无额外角色。
